spec2def(traffic.dll traffic.spec)

# traffic.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/traffic-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(traffic_shims OBJECT traffic_main.c)
target_link_libraries(traffic_shims PRIVATE wine libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(traffic_shims)
add_cargo_module(traffic traffic-cargo traffic.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS traffic_shims psdk)
